name: Halže (Czechia)
description: Two vertical stripes of green and red in the ratio 2:1, with a white triangle issuing from the hoist edge into the green.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 4 June 1998 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
